title: AI VTuber Perception Observation Batch
description: Provider-neutral, bounded perception observations (issue #90, ADR-0007, slice S1a): a closed scene class with closed-vocabulary labels, or one short caption, derived from one operator-chosen screen source. Serialized form of aivtuber_domain::PerceptionObservationBatch. Observation data only: it carries no authority, no priority and no trust claim (the receiving ingress assigns plane and trust: perception is always untrusted content-plane input, and it has no source class because it is not an event envelope event, ADR-0007 D-Q1). There is no image, pixel, hash, embedding, bounding box, OCR transcript or free-form map in this contract. Times are integer milliseconds on the monotonic or logical timeline of the receiving runtime, already mapped there by the adapter; never wall-clock time. expires_at_ms is required. The cross-field rules (captured_at_ms <= observed_at_ms, expires_at_ms after observed_at_ms and within 30000 ms, unique observation_id per batch, caption at most 240 UTF-8 bytes) are not expressible in JSON Schema; the Rust validator and scripts/validate.mjs enforce them. NFKC normalization of the caption is the producer's duty; the pattern and the Rust validator reject the characters NFKC would rewrite in the ranges that matter for Japanese and ASCII input (full-width and half-width forms, the ideographic space).

schema_version.description: Contract version. An incompatible version is refused rather than reinterpreted.

provider_id.description: Adapter or sidecar that produced the observations. Audit data, never read for a decision.

observations.description: Observations in producer order. Bounded. Per-source ordering is by capture_seq and observed_at_ms, never by arrival.

alias.description: Operator-configured label for the captured OBS source. Never a window title, process name or file path: the operator maps the alias to the real source.

frame.description: Identity of the frame the observation was derived from. No pixels, hash or thumbnail.

capture_seq.description: Monotonic per source and producer run.

producer.description: Identity of the non-deterministic producer, so replay and A/B comparison can tell runs apart. The provider identity itself is the batch envelope's.

config_digest.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 over the projector, quantization, sampling and image-size configuration.

redaction.description: Counters only: says that producer-side redaction ran and what it did, without keeping the removed text.

scene_class.description: Provisional closed vocabulary (ADR-0007 D-Q11); the scene context (#88) owns the final one and perception will use its subset. unknown means the producer could not tell and never overrides another source.

labels.description: Closed-vocabulary tokens. The ingress drops, and counts, any token outside the operator profile's label vocabulary (at most 64 entries); the wire form only bounds the shape.

caption.description: The only free text. At most 240 UTF-8 bytes (checked by the Rust validator and scripts/validate.mjs; maxLength counts characters), no control, bidi, zero-width, line-separator or NFKC-unstable compatibility characters. Always untrusted text about a screen, rendered only inside a delimited untrusted slot, never an instruction, never parsed for control or performance information.

kind.description: Closed tagged kind. Turn-cue kinds are reserved for a later slice (ADR-0007) and are not part of this version.

observation_id.description: Unique per batch and per producer session. For replay and metrics correlation.

expires_at_ms.description: Required absolute expiry on the same timeline; after observed_at_ms and at most 30000 ms later. A stale description of a game that has moved on is worse than none.

confidence.description: Optional. A vision model's self-reported confidence is not a probability unless calibrated is true.

privacy.description: Declared by the producer. The ingress may only raise it to the operator source profile's floor, never lower it.
